title: Recent updates
intro: This first version of GroovePlayer includes the library, playback, and account features below.

items.title: Songs
items.detail: Play audio stored in the app library.

items.title: Albums and artists
items.detail: Browse by album or artist and open a page for each.

items.title: Genres
items.detail: Browse songs grouped by genre.

items.title: Search
items.detail: Find songs, albums, and artists from the home search bar.

items.title: Edit song details
items.detail: Change a song’s title, artist, album, genre, and year.

items.title: Create and edit playlists
items.detail: Name a playlist, add and remove tracks, and reorder them.

items.title: Import and export
items.detail: Bring in an M3U playlist or export one.

items.title: Recommendations
items.detail: On an empty playlist, suggested songs appear so you can add them.

items.title: Player
items.detail: Play, pause, skip, and open the full player.

items.title: Queue
items.detail: See what plays next, reorder tracks, and remove them.

items.title: Mini player
items.detail: Keep the current song on screen, and choose whether it shows when the app starts.

items.title: Repeat and shuffle
items.detail: Repeat one song, repeat the queue, or shuffle playback.

items.title: Equalizer
items.detail: Shape the sound with the equalizer.

items.title: Visualization
items.detail: Choose a visual mode while music plays.

items.title: Bluetooth
items.detail: Connect a speaker or headphones from the player.

items.title: Recently played
items.detail: Jump back to songs you played lately.

items.title: Most played
items.detail: See the songs you play the most.

items.title: Favorites
items.detail: Like tracks, artists, and albums, then open them from Home.

items.title: Share music
items.detail: Send songs by tap (NFC) or to a nearby device.

items.title: Backup and restore
items.detail: Back up the library and restore it on this device.

items.title: Account
items.detail: Sign in and use a free, basic, or premium account.

items.title: UI customisation
items.detail: Change colors, type, and spacing.

items.title: Notifications
items.detail: Control playback notifications.

items.title: Storage
items.detail: See storage use, manage excluded folders, and clear cache.
